facts.business: Refex Industries Limited operates a diversified portfolio comprising coal and ash handling services for thermal power plants, wind energy solutions through its subsidiary Venwind Refex Power Limited, and premium corporate mobility services through its subsidiary Refex Green Mobility Limited.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital Expenditure for purchase of tipper lorries, JCBs, excavators, wheel loader and other vehicles

Preferential issue proceeds allocation (revised to ₹115.06 crore)

capacity_or_capex.item: General Corporate Purpose for repaying existing working capital loans and term loans

Confirmed order book of over 400 MW secured within first year of operations

Execution risk in Scheme of Amalgamation and Arrangement for mobility business demerger
